## Details

<a id="UC-001"></a>
### UC-001 — Submit leave request

**Application:** [APP-001](applications.view.md#APP-001) Leave Request Management Web Application

**Description:** An employee requests leave by choosing a leave type, the dates with a day part (All day, Morning, Afternoon) and the Project Manager who will confirm it, and by uploading any documents the leave type requires. Leave is counted on working days only. The system blocks a request with dates outside the allowed window, a missing required document or a leave type the employee is not eligible for. A request that exceeds the entitlement is accepted and flagged for manual review. The selected Project Manager is emailed. A Project Manager's own request is auto-confirmed, and a request from an employee with no project goes straight to the Line Manager.

**Requirements:**

- [REQ-001](../requirements/requirements.view.md#REQ-001) Leave request submission
- [REQ-002](../requirements/requirements.view.md#REQ-002) Requests exceeding the entitlement allowed with manual review
- [REQ-003](../requirements/requirements.view.md#REQ-003) Two-step review and approval workflow
- [REQ-016](../requirements/requirements.view.md#REQ-016) Automated, configurable notification emails

**Business rules:**

- [BR-001](business-rules.view.md#BR-001) Leave date window
- [BR-002](business-rules.view.md#BR-002) Exceeding the entitlement is reviewed, not blocked
- [BR-003](business-rules.view.md#BR-003) Seniority-based entitlement
- [BR-004](business-rules.view.md#BR-004) Gender-specific leave types
- [BR-005](business-rules.view.md#BR-005) Required documentation per leave type
- [BR-007](business-rules.view.md#BR-007) Project Manager self-request is auto-confirmed
- [BR-015](business-rules.view.md#BR-015) Employee selects the confirming Project Manager
- [BR-017](business-rules.view.md#BR-017) Half-day leave
- [BR-018](business-rules.view.md#BR-018) Workflow email notifications
- [BR-021](business-rules.view.md#BR-021) No confirmation for an employee without a project
- [BR-022](business-rules.view.md#BR-022) Working days

**Entities read:**

- [ENT-002](data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-002) Employee
- [ENT-004](data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-004) Leave Type

<a id="UC-006"></a>
### UC-006 — Refresh annual leave entitlements

**Application:** [APP-001](applications.view.md#APP-001) Leave Request Management Web Application

**Description:** At the start of each year the system automatically refreshes leave entitlements: it calculates every employee's entitlement for each leave type as base days plus one day per N years of service, for the leave types the employee is eligible for. No amounts are imported. Requests still pending are then checked against the new entitlements.

**Requirements:**

- [REQ-006](../requirements/requirements.view.md#REQ-006) Annual leave entitlement refresh

**Business rules:**

- [BR-012](business-rules.view.md#BR-012) Annual entitlement refresh
- [BR-003](business-rules.view.md#BR-003) Seniority-based entitlement
- [BR-004](business-rules.view.md#BR-004) Gender-specific leave types

**Entities read:**

- [ENT-002](data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-002) Employee

<a id="UC-008"></a>
### UC-008 — Send weekly attendance notification

**Application:** [APP-001](applications.view.md#APP-001) Leave Request Management Web Application

**Description:** Every Friday the system uses card scanner data to determine each employee's off-work days among the working days of the last week, matches them against the employee's leave requests (any submitted request counts as valid), and emails the employee the absent days without a leave request and the absent days with a valid leave request.

**Requirements:**

- [REQ-005](../requirements/requirements.view.md#REQ-005) Weekly attendance-based notification
- [REQ-011](../requirements/requirements.view.md#REQ-011) Card scanner integration
- [REQ-016](../requirements/requirements.view.md#REQ-016) Automated, configurable notification emails

**Business rules:**

- [BR-010](business-rules.view.md#BR-010) Off-work day definition
- [BR-011](business-rules.view.md#BR-011) Weekly attendance notification
- [BR-022](business-rules.view.md#BR-022) Working days

**Entities read:**

- [ENT-009](data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-009) Attendance Record
- [ENT-006](data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-006) Leave Request
- [ENT-002](data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-002) Employee
- [ENT-010](data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-010) Public Holiday
